ledger_scope: Flagged material claims and ambiguities, after reading all six held-out summary/synthesis outputs against supplied sources. Supported content is described through coverage and review notes; not an exhaustive standardized atomic-claim denominator.
annotation_limits: Qualification loss, event contradiction, citation drift, attribution and ambiguity remain distinct. Flag counts are not independent false-fact totals or comparable precision percentages.
supported_content_review: H1 retains correct officials, conditions, food policy, cavalry mechanism and Adrianople casualties. H2 does not misread Lydus as ignorant or conflate Telemachus with state action. H3 preserves the hypothetical rescue, and H4 retains Andronicus’s residual sight, source John VI numbering and small Western assistance. Attribution is usually explicit.
citation_review: H2-Q4 crosses a page boundary. Summary conditions cite 62 instead of 63; H3 uniformity and wounded care cite 244 instead of 245; Constantine’s compiler assessment spans 246–247. Full control uses prose page references rather than bracketed PDF markers; zero marker count is not absence of citations.
synthesis_review: The merged synthesis largely reproduces all four direct summaries with small edits, carrying all six clear families and ambiguities with it. The independent control repeats two families, covers H1 only before the named battles, mainly the Latin portion of H2, a limited H3 opening, and omits H4. All outputs stopped normally; omissions are not caused by a token cap.
